Crystal Collection — Full Suite, Transparent Tub + Toilet

Art
where no one

BathNoir fixtures are crafted from high-purity optical acrylic — designed as sculptural objects. Total transparency: structure, water, and interior visible from every angle.

Each piece integrates an IP68 camera built directly into the material, controlled from the BathNoir app. Private stream, local recording, or whatever you decide. The hardware is yours. So is the content.

Tier 4 — Sanctuary Series NEW

Water that flows
through the walls.

Hydro-wall technology — integrated vertical channels moulded inside the lateral acrylic walls carry water upward and cascade it over the top rim as a continuous laminar curtain. Continuous micro-bubble lines rise along both long walls. Chromotherapy LED, walnut wood base with amber underglow. Available in two variants: with integrated IP68 cameras or camera-free for maximum simplicity.

Hydro-wall cascade Bubble lateral walls RGB chromotherapy LED Walnut wood base Camera optional Concept stage

With cameras: from 6,900€  ·  Camera-free: from 5,200€
Concept stage — prototype not yet built. Production subject to funding.

Sanctuary Series — Detail view

Inside the wall.
The cascade up close.

Each lateral wall hides an internal water channel invisible from the outside. Water rises through the acrylic wall structure and overflows the top rim as a thin, transparent laminar sheet — catching the chromotherapy light as it falls. A continuous micro-bubble curtain rises along the same wall from perforations at the base. All of this visible through the transparent acrylic from every angle.

Internal wall channels Laminar flow cascade Bubble wall curtain Optical acrylic 8mm
